description: Power-transportation Test Network for Fast Charging Station Pricing is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors 洪儒 王. The topology of the nexus network is modified on the 20-node transportation network and IEEE 33-node electricity network. The system consists of 8 fast charging stations, 2 renewable resources (wind), and three distributed generations. The scenarios of wind uncertainty as well as power system loads are also given in the data. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
